entities.summary: Hinrich Brunsberg, also Heinrich Brunsberg or Henryk Brunsberg, was a German architect who shaped the medieval Brick Gothic style in eastern northern Germany. He worked around 1400, especially in the Margraviate of Brandenburg and in the Duchy of Pomerania.
